entry.title: Star Ocean: The Second Story v0.2.2
entry.content:
# so2.apworld 0.2.2
Version 0.2.2 of the Archipelago world for *Star Ocean: The Second Story* adds **tracker support**. [Universal Tracker](https://github.com/FarisTheAncient/Archipelago/releases) now rebuilds your room exactly, without your YAML, and explains what a location needs. The room carries its own logic, so the new PopTracker pack shows exactly what the world says. And in story mode, with Shattered Stars 0.03.00 connected, both trackers follow the story. It makes the same seeds as 0.2.1 from the same options and seed number, and plays on Shattered Stars 0.02.51 and later.
It has its own release, apart from [the game's](https://github.com/IronJade/Shattered-Stars/releases/tag/v0.03.00) and [the PopTracker pack's](https://github.com/IronJade/Shattered-Stars/releases/tag/poptracker-v1.0.0). Get the game from [Shattered Stars 0.03.00](https://github.com/IronJade/Shattered-Stars/releases/tag/v0.03.00), the pack from [PopTracker pack 1.0.0](https://github.com/IronJade/Shattered-Stars/releases/tag/poptracker-v1.0.0).
## What's new: Universal Tracker
Universal Tracker (UT) is an Archipelago client that lists the locations you can reach right now, by the game's own logic, from what the server says you have received and checked. It builds this world again on your machine and asks it. Until now that only worked by chance: UT made the world again with another random seed and your YAML, and in open world with `character_items`, in hub mode, or in story mode with `character_items`, the party it drew was not yours, so it showed the wrong killer-move levels, crafts and learn levels (30 to 130 locations off in our tests).
Now:
- **No YAML needed.** UT rebuilds the world from the room's own data: every option, your party pool and, in hub mode, your start town. Install `tracker.apworld` and the room's `so2.apworld` in Archipelago's `custom_worlds` folder, open Universal Tracker from the Launcher and connect with your slot name. Your game can stay connected at the same time. - **It is exact.** For every option mix we test (story, open world and hub mode, with and without the bench, every way the party can be drawn), the locations UT lists as reachable are exactly the ones the generator counted on, step by step through the whole game. - **In story order.** UT's list runs through the areas in the order the story reaches them, Arlia first and the Cave of Trials last, then the skill guilds, learn levels, Item Creation and killer moves. - **Excluded locations** (`exclude_locations`) show in UT's excluded group. - **`/explain <location>` says what a location needs.** The world's rules are now data (Archipelago's Rule Builder) instead of code, so UT's `/explain` prints a location's rule, with what you have in green and what is missing in red, and the ways into its region. The logic is the same as 0.2.1's, rule for rule. - **A room it can't track is refused, not tracked wrong.** Each room now says which logic it was made with (`logic_version`, 1). If the so2.apworld you installed can't rebuild the room (a room made with a newer version of this world, for example), UT says "The world has informed UT that your options are incompatible", and its `/faris_asked` command names the so2.apworld to install. - **Universal Tracker's map tab.** UT now shows a map tab too: it carries its own map and location data (`apworld/so2/ut_map.py`, `apworld/so2/tracker/`) and takes its pictures from a zip, which UT asks you for once, by a file dialog, and remembers in `host.yaml`: either `so2_shattered_stars_ut.zip`, your own maps, which Shattered Stars 0.03.00 writes when it renders them from your disc (setup's **Render tracker maps for PopTracker**, or `--render-tracker-maps`), or the PopTracker pack's zip, with its plain stand-in maps. It follows the room the game reports and shows a marker for your party on the two world maps. When UT connects, the map tab opens on Expel's world map (with your marker if you are there) and follows your game from its next move: the next room, or a step on a world map. It has no doors: a door is not an AP location, entrance or event, so it carries no "which door leads where" of its own (that's PopTracker, below).
## What's new: logic for PopTracker
The room now carries the world's logic as data (the slot data's `tracker` key: its regions, entrances, events and every location's rule, about 4 to 35 KB), so a tracker that can't run the world itself can still show exactly what it says. The **PopTracker pack** (`so2_shattered_stars` 1.0.0, its own release) reads it: with a 0.2.2 room its map and board squares are green when a check is in logic and red when not, the same as Universal Tracker, for every option and seed. The format already has room for an entrance randomizer later: named entrances, and doors that stay unconnected until found.
## What's new: story mode follows the story
Story mode's chapters need no items, so by the logic alone almost every check is reachable from the start, and a tracker listed checks in towns the party hadn't reached yet. With Shattered Stars 0.03.00 connected to the room, the game tells the server which chapter it is in, and both trackers now follow it: - **Universal Tracker** lists only what the story has reached: a town's checks join the list when the story takes you there, Energy Nede's after the disc switch, the Cave of Trials and the chapter-60 scenes on Expel after the Final Save Point. It follows the chapter live, also back to an earlier save. `enforce_deferred_entrances: "off"` in host.yaml (UT's setting) turns it off. - **The PopTracker pack** shows the checks later in the story in blue (and those the story has reached green, as before); its **Story** item turns that off, and its **Chapter** item can be set by hand when the game isn't connected. - Before the game has connected, with an older Shattered Stars, and in open world and hub mode (whose stages are keyed) both show what the logic alone says, as before.
The story is followed by its 24 points: the start of each of the 23 story stages, and the Final Save Point (chapter 60, step 4000). A stage is the unit: a gift first given in the middle of a stage shows from the stage's start.
## Older rooms
- **Rooms made with 0.2.1** track in Universal Tracker with 0.2.2 installed, exactly: 0.2.1's logic is 0.2.2's. - **Rooms made with 0.2.0** track with 0.2.2 too. With `skillsanity` on, UT warns in its log that 0.2.1 changed the logic of Skillsanity's guild checks and learn levels (they may hold progression since, with stricter rules of their own): some of them may show up **later** than they really became reachable, never earlier. Measured on 45 such rooms (29 showed fewer at some point, 16 the same, none more) and on a player's own; regenerate with 0.2.2 for exact tracking. - **A 0.2.0 hell seed** (`encounter_rate: 0` with killer-move checks) is refused: track it with so2.apworld 0.2.0 and your YAML in UT's Players folder. - **In PopTracker**, rooms made with 0.2.0 or 0.2.1 have no logic in them: the pack shows every check as reachable (a checklist) and its banner says so. The pack's story awareness needs a 0.2.2 room too.
## Your seeds
- **The seeds are the same.** 0.2.2 puts the same items in the same places as 0.2.1 from the same options and seed number, with the same spoilers (checked over the release workflow's 288 seeds). Only the version number written into the seed changes. The room's slot data gains three keys for trackers, `logic_version`, `exclude_locations` and `tracker` (in story mode with the story's points), which the game doesn't read. - There are no new options: a YAML from 0.2.1 works as it is. - Shattered Stars 0.02.51 plays every 0.2.2 seed; 0.02.50 every one without the bench, as with 0.2.1. Shattered Stars 0.03.00 also tells your trackers your map and story.
## Installing
1. Copy `so2.apworld` into the `custom_worlds` folder of **Archipelago 0.6.8 or newer**, replacing the old one. Keep only one copy: Archipelago refuses to load the same game twice. 2. Generate as usual, with your options YAML or the template, `Star.Ocean.The.Second.Story.yaml`. 3. Play the seed on [Shattered Stars 0.03.00](https://github.com/IronJade/Shattered-Stars/releases/tag/v0.03.00) (0.02.51 plays it too, without the map and story for trackers). 4. Trackers: for Universal Tracker, put its `tracker.apworld` beside this `so2.apworld`; for PopTracker, get the [pack](https://github.com/IronJade/Shattered-Stars/releases/tag/poptracker-v1.0.0). How to set both up: [Trackers](https://github.com/IronJade/Shattered-Stars/wiki/Trackers) on the wiki.
Details, every option, and troubleshooting: [Archipelago](https://github.com/IronJade/Shattered-Stars/wiki/Archipelago) on the wiki.
## What's in this release
| File | What it is | |---|---| | `so2.apworld` | The Archipelago world for Star Ocean: The Second Story, version 0.2.2. | | `Star.Ocean.The.Second.Story.yaml` | The options template for that world. | | `SHA256SUMS` | The SHA-256 sums of the two files (also below). |
The game itself is Shattered Stars, from [its own release](https://github.com/IronJade/Shattered-Stars/releases/tag/v0.03.00) (0.03.00 for the tracker keys; 0.02.51 plays the seeds too).
The world was checked with its own tests (882, unchanged by the map tab), Archipelago's general tests (379, and 935 scoped to this world), the slow tests' 700 rooms (320 rebuilt the way UT does and compared at every sphere, 320 whose logic export was evaluated at every sphere, 60 story rooms at 27 story positions each), the release workflow's 288 seeds, the same as 0.2.1's but the version number (the map tab adds no slot-data key), and the real Universal Tracker 0.3.6 and PopTracker 0.36.0 against local rooms: UT's list was the world's own in all 59 comparisons, the story ones included; PopTracker's squares were too, at every point of its 45 checks (37 logic and story checks, plus the room maps' door-click, door-colour and auto-tab step); and UT's own map tab loaded 16/16 of those rooms correctly, both from the repository world and from the packaged `so2.apworld`, with the pack's zip and with the game's own zip of a render (every page's picture through UT's own image loader).
## Known limitations
- **Story awareness follows stages, not single scenes.** A gift first given in the middle of a stage shows from the stage's start; Fienal's floors count from the last chapters' stage (chapter 58), though the party enters at chapter 60; the Final Save Point counts from the step before the save (chapter 60, step 4000). - **PopTracker shows no "out of logic" (yellow).** The room's logic says what is in logic, not what could be done out of it. - **Universal Tracker: don't turn Auto Tab off before UT connects.** With Auto Tab turned off (`/toggle_auto_tab`) before its first connect of a session, UT 0.3.6 drops the connection when it connects (an `AttributeError` about `location_icons` in its log; UT's own issue): connect first (once connected, the checkbox is fine), or turn it back on and `/connect` again. - **Trackers update only while the game is online**: checks made offline show once the game reconnects and sends them. - The rest: see the [Shattered Stars 0.03.00 release notes](https://github.com/IronJade/Shattered-Stars/releases/tag/v0.03.00).
## For developers
- `apworld/so2/ut.py`: the slot data -> option table, the checks, the refusal, the sort order, `LOGIC_VERSION` and when to bump it. docs/apworld/apworld.md "Trackers" and docs/apworld/seed_format.md "Slot data and trackers". - `apworld/so2/logic.py`: the rules as Rule Builder data; `test/test_logic.py` keeps every rule a serialisable Rule Builder rule (docs/apworld/apworld.md "Rules as data"). - `test/test_ut.py` mirrors UT's rebuild and its fuzzer hook's sphere-by-sphere check without UT installed; `SO2_SLOW_TESTS=1` runs 20 seeds per mix. `trackers/tools/ap_ut_check.py` runs the real UT client headless against a local room (the release workflow). - `apworld/so2/tracker_export.py` writes the `tracker` key (format 1: docs/apworld/seed_format.md "The tracker export"); `trackers/tools/ap_tracker_logic.py` is the reference evaluator, and `test/test_tracker.py` checks it against the world's own logic sphere by sphere and on random item states for every UT mix (`SO2_SLOW_TESTS=1`: 20 seeds each), plus the export's shape, round trip and size. The PopTracker pack's Lua evaluator is tested against the reference (trackers/tools/ap_poptracker_test.py) and in the real PopTracker 0.36.0 (trackers/tools/ap_poptracker_smoke.py). - `apworld/so2/story.py`: story awareness, one source for both trackers: the story's points, each location's point, the export's `story` key, and Universal Tracker's deferred story events (`found_entrances_datastorage_key` = the port's `so2_story_{team}_{player}`, `reconnect_found_entrances`; only in UT's regeneration of a story-mode room, never with `enforce_deferred_entrances` off). docs/apworld/apworld.md "Story awareness", docs/apworld/seed_format.md "Story awareness". `test/test_story.py` checks UT's in-logic set against the reference evaluator's at every story point; trackers/tools/ap_ut_check.py and trackers/tools/ap_poptracker_smoke.py set the story key on a local server as the game does and check both real trackers follow it (UT: 142 of 578 checks at chapter 3 up to all 578 at the Final Save Point; PopTracker: 37 green and 546 blue at chapter 3).
## SHA-256 sums
``` 0212e0fd0c811cc8261ac3740d10694c98515d3dae7f2c05c6bb212ff175cdf7 so2.apworld 09b32d474b303daea70cddc3d86520f591182e5a063d4180a0f77f2c7cbb5c68 Star.Ocean.The.Second.Story.yaml ```

entry.content:
# v0.30.0 — Bunker and True Ending
October 28, 2026. Client 0.77.0 / APWorld 0.30.0.
## New progression
- Optional True Ending victory alongside the default King Ferdinand ending. - Randomized Bunker Keycard, Demon Key, Virus, Cheat Codes and Game Ender, plus six new checks. - Bunker progression defaults to enabled; requires at least two goal Stars. The Bunker Star Eater always requires fewer Stars than the Level 22 entrance and its Superstar cartridge source is randomized. - The Demon Key controls the separate Devil quest; Gecko's Data Stick and Note Pad remain native quest setup. - New seeds open Demolition Training and School Trip doors with Lobby Access, retaining generated Star gates. - Cell Tower Access opens Old Tom's connecting route without nectar delivery; read the note and leave/re-enter the area to update the Star Eater route.
## Fixes and cleanup
- Correct incompatible Bunker/goal settings to raise Archipelago OptionError, rather than generation crashes. - Replace an unsafe native event conversion implicated in final-level transition crashes. - Remove F8 movement recording and temporary profiling/diagnostic callbacks while preserving movement repairs and ordinary error logging. - Add schema21 Universal Tracker reconstruction and preserve legacy schema19/20 rules.
## Updating and validation
Install the client archive with its licenses and scrc.apworld into Archipelago's custom_worlds folder while applications are closed. Use a fresh seed and native save for the new Bunker options. Existing schema19/20 rooms retain their original placements and rules; do not regenerate an active room. Keep its YAML for Universal Tracker. The Ionium YAML creator may still offer the previous indexed version until this release is indexed.
The corrected APWorld passed Ionium's full browser CI preset on Archipelago 0.6.7 and 0.6.8: 458 unit tests, 29,000 attempted fuzz cases, zero failures/timeouts, including Universal Tracker. Invalid option combinations were correctly ignored. Version metadata is updated for this release; index CI remains authoritative.
The native Gecko quest and final ending were investigated in staged saves, but the complete randomized schema21 receipt/source/goal flow has not yet completed an end-to-end gameplay acceptance run. Intermittent performance reports and broader multiplayer coverage remain open. See [known issues](https://github.com/Akamarus/Super-Crazy-Rhythm-Castle-Archipelago/blob/v0.30.0/docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md) and [testing](https://github.com/Akamarus/Super-Crazy-Rhythm-Castle-Archipelago/blob/v0.30.0/docs/TESTING.md).

entry.title: Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles v0.2.0
entry.content:
## New Features
- Victory Goal: Monster Hunt. Defeat at least one of every enemy type or every enemy in every cycle! Chests are no longer checks (Keep in mind that if you enable every enemy as a check, you will have over 1000 checks!)
- Shop Checks: The first purchase from each shop slot is a check, 94 slots in 8 shops. Each shop sells the same stock all game. Tipa's shop is excluded, since it only exists with a Merchant family. Shella's shop expects Veo Lu Sluice first, for the Shella Mark.
- Mog Stamp Hints (on by default): each new Mog Stamp hints where one of your progression items is, in any world.
- New AP item model: It no longer looks like a bag but looks like the AP logo!
### New Options
- Hotspot Elements: the elemental pools change element every year.
Match Miasma Streams: each side of the world gets the elements its streams need that year. This seems to be the fix for most of the soft locks due to having the miasma streams randomized! Shuffled: random elements each year. May end up with more soft locks but thought I would still give it as a option for players. The client still has the /element command just in case you get stuck!
A dungeon keeps its usual number of elements. The world-map name bubble and the "Change element" menus follow the year too.
- Progressive Artifact Order: game order, strength first, magic first, defense first, or random.
- Progression Cycles: play only Cycle 1, or Cycles 1-2. Later cycles hold only filler. Makes seeds a bit faster!
- Dungeon shortcuts, one option each! Makes it a lot faster to get to the end of stages! These options do not change any logic but are only to be helpful to the player.
River Belle Path bridges (Not a big shortcut but I thought I would include it) Goblin Wall gates (All the gates are open in both areas. Making it fast to go to the boss!) Mine boxes (No longer need to keep on hitting the cart to play the stage) Tida webs (Webs don't show up to make it faster on the player!) Moschet Manor doors (Doors will open up right away as you enter the area) Selepation Cave elevators (Elevators start lowered) Conall Curach log bridges (The log bridges start enabled in the stage) Rebena Te Ra gates (All magic puzzle gates are opened!) Lynari Desert Unknown puzzle (I kept forgetting this puzzle order so this saved me some time haha)
- Chest Color Matches Contents: gold chests hold progression items!
- Hide Collected Chests: chests whose check is done don't appear. Some players may want to farm the chest resources while others want to be able to see the chests they missed.
- Magicite Needs Its Ring: magicite only works once you have its ring. Just in case the game wasn't hard enough already :)
- Best Bonus Tier: the end-of-dungeon bonus always offers the best tier.
- Items Dropped At Your Feet: received items land on the ground in front of you instead of directly into your bag. Might help players who want to do some interesting Co-op play!
- Keep Picked-Up Artifacts: picked-up artifacts go straight to your artifact list instead of inside the temporary treasures UI. This will work with any player who picks up the artifact and not just player 1!
- Mog stamp hints! Every mog stamp will give you a new hint for a progressive item.
## Fixes / Changes
- Progressive Equipment pieces now go into your bag to equip, instead of replacing your gear. - The apworld decides the bonus rewards, so the poptracker can show them. Great tracking for you players who want to farm bonus rewards :) - Code clean up for my own sanity!
### Logic
- Shuffle Loading Zones fix: ring-gated dungeons only count once a dungeon with no ring requirement is reachable. Some seeds used to fail to generate. - Stream elements, hotspots and the "Change element" menus are worked out year by year. - Town shops need their area's year. The Fields of Fum also need the river crossing, and Shella needs Veo Lu Sluice.
### Client
- New commands:
/cycle - Show / change cycle of any stage! /bonus - Shows the current bonus condition, does the math to show the current bonus value! Great for you 100% players out there! /hunt - Shows the remaining enemy types and the best place to find them! /resend - Drops the last item again just in case something goes wrong. /deathlink - on, off or default. The choice is remembered through reconnects. Just in case you change your mind about deathlink during play. This game can get difficult!
- Items are delivered in towns too, dropped once the shop menu is closed. - Reports the year, dungeon cycles, current stage and bonus picks to the trackers.
### Universal Tracker
- The map page shows every pack pin (chests, enemies, shop slots) and highlights hinted ones. - UT rebuilds the seed with its own layout, streams, hotspot and menu tables, so its logic matches generation.

entry.title: DOOM Eternal v0.7.1r2
entry.content:
# DOOM Eternal Archipelago v0.7.2
Bug fixes for Linux installation, encounters that unlock too early or never end, and Support Report diagnostics.
Use **Mod 0.7.2** and **APWorld 0.7.1** with **Sentinel Core 1.1.3**.
## Launcher and room preparation
- Fixed Linux/Proton installations being reported as "Installation could not be checked" after a correct install, for rooms without DLC missions and for every room's Fortress of Doom resources. - Fixed the Linux/Proton installer breaking on its first run after a game update, file verification, or a reset of installer backups when files from a previous room were still present. - Repaired stale or empty installer resource maps before running the installer, so it rebuilds them instead of failing later with an unclear error. - Installation failures now state the step that failed and the cause, instead of a generic message. - Fixed Linux/Proton sessions failing with "Session request is too large" for rooms with large enemy plans.
## Encounters and enemy randomization
- Fixed waits for a specific demon type not counting the replacements of that demon, which could open gates while replacements were still alive (for example, the key encounter in **Super Gore Nest**) or keep a fight waiting forever (for example, the **Super Gore Nest** Slayer Gate with endlessly respawning fodder). - Fixed Spirits spawning in unreachable spots in **UAC Atlantica Facility**, which could leave the last enemy of an encounter out of reach. Those spawn points now use a Cacodemon. - Hell Knight and Spirit health and remaining-enemy waits now track replacements by the enemy they replaced (for example, the catapult fight in **Immora**).
## Encounter recovery
- Added the `ap_finish_encounter` console command to get out of a stuck combat encounter. It stops the encounter's spawners, defeats its remaining demons, and lets the encounter end normally, so doors, music, the encounter's check, and checkpoints still trigger. - It only affects the active encounter, gives no Killsanity credit for the demons it defeats, and is refused during boss fights. - Each use is recorded in Support Reports.
## Support Reports and diagnostics
- Support Reports now include the full installer output, the installer state before and after each run, and the failing installation step with its error. - Added diagnostics for enemy removal, replacement counting in waits, spawn positions, checkpoint saving, power-up delivery, and recent crash reports from Windows Error Reporting. - Kept more of the game console around the latest encounter event and separated the current session's item queue from older entries.
**These fixes do not require a new room. Rooms that work with v0.7.1 keep working, and the Atlantica spawn fix applies when the launcher prepares the room package again.**

entry.title: Team Fortress 2 Mann vs Machine v1.18.5
entry.content: ## Changes ### Added - **Six new traps**, contributed by Lee Harrold: Team Mad Milk, Team On Fire, Team Slow Down, Team Bleed, Team Marked For Death and Team Gas. Each hits everybody on RED for ten seconds, like Team Jarate. They are off by default: turn them on one by one under Rewards in the launcher, or list them in the `traps` option. A run made before them still holds Team Jarate alone. - A seed made with this apworld needs this launcher or a newer one. An older launcher refuses it when it connects and says to use the launcher the seed was made for, instead of quietly dropping a trap it does not know. Seeds made before keep playing on this one. ### Fixed - **Servers work on the TF2 update of 29 October 2026.** Windows servers load SigMod again, so the community missions that need it start at their first wave instead of staying on wave 0. - **Attribute lookups on the server read the right memory.** The plugin's TF2Attributes lookup handed over its result in the form SourceMod 1.13 uses, to a TF2Attributes that did not read it that way. TF2Attributes is now the int64 port, compiled for 1.13. - **The defender bots run on SourceMod 1.13**, the same build as the server, with the current Actions (v4.0.1) and TF Econ Data. Before, the bots were compiled with 1.12 because their dependencies did not compile on 1.13. - **Max ammo and max metal buffs fill you up again when you spawn.** Since 1.18.3 an Engineer with a max metal buff started on 200 metal and only got 300 at the next resupply. Spawning and resupplying now give the buffed amount. A buff rebuild in the middle of a life still never adds ammo, so the Windows pile-up stays fixed. - **The Docker stack only draws from the community packs you ticked.** With `MVM_EXCLUDED_MISSIONS` empty, `make seed` and the self-hosted multiworld could pick a mission from a pack unticked in the admin page, and the admin page counted those missions in the tier menu and the mission count. They are now left out. A `.env` without `TF2AP_COMMUNITY_PACKS` still draws from every pack, as before; an empty one draws from none. - **The Docker server plays like the launcher's.** It went to sleep when the last player left, ignored the robot health set in the admin page, and loaded SigMod whenever it was ticked rather than only when a mission in the pool needs it. It now writes the same server.cfg and command line as the launcher. The launcher in turn now keeps RED defenders out of SigMod's robot limit, as Docker already did. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. The exe unpacks archives and starts a game server without a code signature, which looks like a virus to a scanner. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or check it below first. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux Download **`tf2ap-linux-amd64`**. Run it. It installs everything else. ```sh chmod +x tf2ap-linux-amd64 ./tf2ap-linux-amd64 ``` [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-linux.html) ## Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. Expect a few heuristic detections and no named malware family. The source is all in the repository, and `make launcher` rebuilds the exe on your own machine. ## Code signing policy Free code signing for open source projects, provided by [SignPath.org](https://signpath.org), with a certificate from the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). > [!WARNING] > The application is open, not granted. Nothing is signed yet: `tf2ap.exe` ships > unsigned, and Windows warns about it until that changes. ## What's Changed * refactor(settings): declare each environment variable once by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/239 * fix(settings): leave unticked community packs out of the pool and the seed by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/240 * refactor(srcds): one source for server.cfg, args and mods by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/237 * fix(launcher): bot lineup save and card apply report what really happened by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/244 * fix(plugin): give the buffed ammo again at spawn and resupply by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/245 * chore(go): bump to 1.27.3 by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/227 * fix(bots): stop the SourceMod 1.13 crashes at wave start by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/247 * Add daily full-catalog stability checks and percentage badges by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/243 * chore(deps): pin everything keyed to TF2 11185272 by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/250 * chore(deps): tooling, images and modules to latest stable by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/249 * chore(release): v1.18.5 by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/251 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/compare/v1.18.4...v1.18.5 ## VirusTotal - [`tf2ap.exe`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/Y2Q4NWI0ZDExYTFjNjZjMGY5ZDhkOWM2OWNmMGEyYzA6MTc5MzM5MzU4OQ==/detection) - [`tf2ap-linux-amd64`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/ODQ1NzkwZjY0YWI5ODQ3Y2ZhOWFjOWVmNzUxNWYxMjA6MTc5MzM5MzU5MQ==/detection)

## New features - Characters & Suits have been added as items and locations in the APWorld - Options to shuffle Ras & Hush and customize the number of minikits/hostages needed (items) - Options to simplify the logic for Characters that require a whole hero episode (nightwing, etc.) or all hero episodes (bat tank) - Minikit Grouping - Minikits can now be grouped in packs of 1, 2, 5, or 10 - Cheaper Shops - you can now lower shop prices - Options to customize how many multipliers are needed for shop purchases based on price (after the effects of cheaper shops) - Option to start with Power Brick & Minikit Detectors - Rewrote logic to use Rule Builder so it is now compatible with the /explain function in UT - A map pack for UT is being worked on - Purple stud support - A few minor name rewording & cleanup - Please note that due to initial playtesting, power bricks and character tokens are coupled and not decoupled. That means you have to collect the character or power brick in level and then purchase it for 1 check. There consequently will only be 1 item (Character/Power brick unlocked) - Please note that logic only takes Freeplay into consideration. Story mode is not considered in logic ever.
There have been multiple versions of this release over the past year trying to fix bugs so if I missed any new features or updates, I apologize.

entry.title: Crab Champions v2.0.0
entry.content:
Crab Champions Archipelago 2.0.0 supports the newest Crab Champions update and is the biggest release so far. It adds a biome lock and a biome check layout, traps and Perk Boosts, a new in-game Archipelago window opened from the pause menu, a rewritten set of options with groups and presets, and a lot of reliability work around reconnects and inventory handling.
## Upgrade: read this first
Some things will catch people out.
- **Biome Lock is on by default.** New worlds need Access items to enter biomes. Add `biome_lock: false` to your yaml to keep the game's normal biome order. - **Several options were removed or merged**, so regenerate your template with **Generate Template Options** and start from the new yaml. Remove `cascade_ranked_checks`, `limit_pickup_pool`, `limit_pickup_locations`, `trap_weight_*`, `perk_boost_max_per_run` and `perk_boost_level_cap`. Use `limit_pickups` and `trap_weights` instead. Archipelago only warns about unknown options, so an old yaml still generates, but removed options do nothing. - **Runs start with only part of your received items now.** To get the old "start every run with everything", set `starting_item_percentage: 100`. - **Reinstall the whole zip** and let Windows replace files. The updated `CrabInvMngmt` DLL is needed (full-inventory pickups, the crash fix and the frame hook), and `mods.txt` and `UE4SS-settings.ini` are replaced. If you use other UE4SS mods, add their lines back to `mods.txt`. - **Open the connection window from the pause menu.** F3 and F4 no longer do anything. - **Worlds made with 1.4.0 and earlier still play.** The same checks and items apply as before, except: All You Can Eat is now a relic in the game, Aura Explosion no longer exists (receiving it gives nothing, and its check is sent when you connect), and items added by the 2.0 update are ordinary pickups there with no check. - Needs Archipelago 0.6.6 or newer.
## What is new
**Biomes** - **Biome Lock** (on by default). Each biome (Tropical, Ice, Desert, Volcano) needs its Access item before your runs can enter it. You start with the Access item of the biome you pick with **Starting Biome** (or a random one). If the next biome in a run is locked, the run goes to a biome you own instead. - **Biome check layout** (`check_layout: biome`). Checks are named per biome and island slot ("Complete Ice Island 1", "Reach Desert Shop"). A 56-island run also gets a second set of "Loop 2" checks. - In the biome layout, a run counts toward the goal only when it clears islands in all four biomes. Island checks, including island 28, still send as before.
**Traps and Perk Boost** - Eight traps, off by default: Crystal Tax, Slowdown, Weak Shots, Bruise, Grow, Shrink, Heavy Gravity and Floaty Gravity. None is permanent and none can kill you. They end on a timer, when the island ends (Slowdown), when you die or when you return to the lobby. A reconnect or a game restart never fires the same trap twice. Set the share of filler with `trap_percentage`, pick which traps appear with `trap_weights`, and tune duration, grace time and strength. - **Perk Boost** filler: adds levels to a random perk you are holding (`perk_boost_count`, `perk_boost_levels`).
**Items and checks** - Support for the game update's new items, including the Potent Claws and Prismatic Claws melee mods. - `starting_item_percentage` and `biome_item_percentage`: each run starts with only part of your received perks, mods and relics, and clearing the last island of a biome gives you another share. Runs no longer start with everything once you have received a lot. Set the starting share to 100 to get the old behaviour. - `granted_item_checks`: choose whether receiving an item also completes its pickup check. A pickup only counts as a find if it came from loot, a chest, a totem or the shop. Items you dropped, the lobby's free item and items the mod spawned no longer count. - `starting_melee` and `starting_abilities`, next to `starting_weapons`. - Open pickup checks can be grabbed even with a full inventory: the check is sent and the item is removed again.
**Window and menus** - An **Archipelago button at the top of the pause menu** opens the connection window. The F3 and F4 keys are gone. - Click **Connect** to connect, disconnect or retry, and use the new **Close** button to hide the window. - The window has a new look: two equal panels under a title strip, coloured goal and biome bars, and long lists that fit on screen. It shows which biomes are unlocked and each weapon's, melee's and ability's cleared biomes, plus your slot, seed, server, items received and checks sent. - Clear connection messages (wrong slot, wrong password, wrong game, version mismatch), and "Could not reach the server" after 10 seconds. - The mouse pointer and clicks are turned on while the window is open and restored when it closes. - The HUD crystal count updates when Archipelago adds or takes crystals.
**Options** - Options are grouped (Goal, Equipment, Run Checks, Biomes, Pickup Checks, Inventory Slots, Received Items, Traps, Perk Boost, Multiplayer) and there are three presets: Short and easy, Standard, Long grind. - A world that is too small for its slot items or guaranteed items now stops with a clear message, and options that generation adjusts print a warning saying what changed.
**Install** - The release zip now includes UE4SS 3.0.1, already set up. Installing is one drag of the `CrabChampions` folder into the game folder.
## Changed
- The "On Bronze" checks are gone. Every clear is at least Bronze, so the plain checks are the Bronze checks, and ranked checks start at Silver. Location IDs are unchanged. - A higher rank always counts for every lower rank (`cascade_ranked_checks` is removed). `minimize_run_checks` keeps the plain island check. - `limit_pickup_pool` and `limit_pickup_locations` became one `limit_pickups` choice. - `melee_in_pool` and `abilities_in_pool` default to 3. - Difficulty modifiers unlock without raising your account rank to Prismatic, so the mod no longer triggers rank achievements. - Steam achievement writes are blocked while the mod is active.
## Fixes
- Reconnecting to the same seed keeps your inventory and crystals and only adds what is missing. A reconnect in the middle of a run keeps the run, and DeathLinks keep working. - Received inventory slots survive the start of a run, and a run can no longer start with more perks than your slots allow. - Seeds that could not be beaten, and generation errors, found with random option mixes: the goal no longer asks for melee or abilities when that count is 0, a yaml that excludes many locations now builds, and Universal Tracker rebuilds the same world as the seed. - Checks made before connecting are ignored instead of sent late, and queued checks are dropped when you connect to a different seed or slot.
## Under the hood
The mod's work now runs on the game's own thread, once per frame, which removes a source of random crashes and freezes. Looked-up game objects are remembered instead of searched for on every timer tick, which helps frame rate.
## Installing
1. `crabchampions.apworld` into `<Archipelago>\custom_worlds\`. 2. `CrabChampionsAP_v2.0.0.zip`: unzip it and drag the `CrabChampions\` folder into your game folder (Steam Library > right-click Crab Champions > Properties > Installed Files > Browse), merging and replacing files when Windows asks. UE4SS 3.0.1 is included and already set up. `INSTALL.txt` inside the zip has the details.
Verify by launching the game and checking `UE4SS.log` (in `CrabChampions\Binaries\Win64\`) for:
``` [CrabAP] Archipelago mod loaded (AP enabled) ```
Then open the pause menu: **Archipelago** is the top button.
## Reporting
Please include your yaml, the seed's spoiler if you have it, and `CrabChampions\Binaries\Win64\UE4SS.log`. The log is what makes a report actionable; without it most issues are guesswork.
